close_reason:
Landed: ClosureHandler in jmap-server now takes a CallerCtx type parameter and forwards it to the wrapped closure. The previous ClosureHandlerWithCtx sibling has been deleted (its capabilities merged into bare ClosureHandler, which is what the workspace AGENTS.md canonical-template idiom prefers). All 7 extension server crates (mail/chat/calendars/contacts/filenode/sharing/tasks) updated to use the unified name in both their re-exports and their register_*_handlers macros. Doc-comments and README caveats refreshed to match. Workspace is pre-publication so the API break has zero ecosystem cost; coordinates with JMAP-g7wu.1's planned 0.2 bump.

Quality gates green: cargo check --workspace --all-targets, cargo test --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo fmt --all --check, RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings cargo doc --no-deps --workspace.

Pre-existing --all-features failure in jmap-mail-server's sieve module (8x E0004 non-exhaustive patterns) spotted in passing; filed separately as JMAP-6i06, NOT addressed here.
description:
Site: crate-jmap-server/src/lib.rs:271

ClosureHandler in the jmap-server foundation crate doesn't take CallerCtx. Forwarding it requires changing the closure signature. Adopt the shape from JMAP-g7wu.1's MailBackend canonical pass.

Since jmap-server is the foundation crate the *-server crates depend on, this either lands first or co-lands with the canonical.
title: CallerCtx forwarding through ClosureHandler in jmap-server (foundation)
